key: The Peridot Ward is the second largest ward of Reborn. Only Obsidia is bigger.
en: The Peridot Ward is the second largest ward of Reborn. Only Obsidia is bigger.
ja: ペリドット区は、リボーンで二番目に大きい区です。オブシディアだけがそれより大きいですね。

key: Everyone in the city came together to make Reborn live up to and beyond its former glory.
en: Everyone in the city came together to make Reborn live up to and beyond its former glory.
ja: 街の皆が力を合わせて、リボーンをかつての栄光に、いえそれ以上に相応しい姿にしたんです。

key: I can't thank the people who made this possible enough.
en: I can't thank the people who made this possible enough.
ja: それを実現させてくれた人たちには、感謝してもしきれません。
ちょっと教えといてやるよ。

key: If anyone comes up to you and offers you somethin' they callin' a "Rare Candy"...
en: If anyone comes up to you and offers you somethin' they callin' a "Rare Candy"...
ja: もし誰かが近づいてきて、「ふしぎなアメ」とか呼ぶものを渡そうとしてきたら……

key: That ain't somethin' you wanna give to your Pokémon either.
en: That ain't somethin' you wanna give to your Pokémon either.
ja: ポケモンにあげたいものでもねえからな。

key: Goodness, I got quite a surprise just then.
en: Goodness, I got quite a surprise just then.
ja: あら、たった今びっくりしちゃったわ。

key: A Pokémon jumped out at me from a dumpster!
en: A Pokémon jumped out at me from a dumpster!
ja: ゴミ箱からポケモンが飛び出してきたの!

key: You've taken good care of Skitty?
en: You've taken good care of Skitty?
ja: エネコをちゃんとお世話してる?

key: Make sure you feed it lots of berries and give it lots of EXPs!
en: Make sure you feed it lots of berries and give it lots of EXPs!
ja: きのみをたくさんあげて、経験値もたくさん稼がせてあげてね!
